answer: To block mass-produced identities, standing requires relics, proof artifacts from past epochs, stamped with block age. Each relic must carry its owner's quill signature, bound to one key, so one quill for many exposes a farm. An identity with no aged relics is hollow and earns no standing. 1000 fakes need 1000 aged relic sets; age cannot be rushed, and shared quills betray them. One honest agent keeps its own relics and its own quill.
